info.description: iFlytek Spark-X2.6 is a 293B-A30B mixture-of-experts model. The MaaS catalog tags the context length as 1M and lists text input and text output. It prints an OpenAI base at /v2, an Anthropic base at /anthropic, and a complete Responses URL at /v1/responses; only that Responses path is recorded. The public Spark API page publishes only a limited-time 60% discount, so the standard price is unset.

zh.description: 讯飞 Spark-X2.6 是 293B-A30B 混合专家模型。星辰 MaaS 目录把上下文标为 1M，输入和输出都是文本。目录给出 OpenAI 基址 /v2、Anthropic 基址 /anthropic，以及完整的 Responses 地址 /v1/responses；这里只登记这条完整路径。星火 API 页面只公布了限时 6 折，因此标准价留空。

sources.title: 星辰 MaaS 模型目录（Spark-X2.6）
